parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the door and base.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet door and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, typically with hinges and a handle for access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of MDF for stability and load distribution.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures it stands level on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.
